test_title: PYST 47: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 6th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Five persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Shweta is to the immediate left of Kartik. Mahi is second to the right of Jenny. Jenny is between Suvarna and Kartik. Who is sitting second to the right of Suvarna?
solution:
Five persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1) Shweta is to the immediate left of Kartik.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0038080eb7bdca96e3f4f298a15b75414f417abbcf60f19b63dab764f0bc201.png] 

2) Jenny is between Suvarna and Kartik and Mahi is second to the right of Jenny.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fb66cab3913f03a40ded13064ba556695a871e831284e078d2acbcaeb7b5704.png] 

Shweta sitting second to the right of Suvarna

Hence, the correct answer is **"Shweta".**
